title: Accounting & Bookkeeping Services Proposal for Old Trout Puppet Workshop
executive_summary: Old Trout Puppet Workshop, a distinguished non-profit touring and multidisciplinary puppet theatre company, faces significant operational challenges as its Executive Director currently manages the bulk of day-to-day administrative and financial tasks. With an annual operating budget fluctuating between $800,000 and $550,000, and a September-to-August fiscal year, the organization requires a robust financial infrastructure to support its artistic mission and prepare for a potential merger. The existing bookkeeping arrangement, limited to basic monthly reconciliations, falls short of providing the audit-ready records, systematic documentation, multi-account reconciliation, and project-level tracking essential for effective governance and strategic planning. Sympl Solutions proposes a comprehensive outsourced bookkeeping and financial administration partnership. Our approach will relieve the Executive Director of the administrative burden, establish rigorous financial controls, ensure complete documentation in QuickBooks Online, and deliver timely, accurate financial reporting tailored for the Board's Financial Committee. This engagement is designed to provide Old Trout Puppet Workshop with the financial clarity, operational efficiency, and audit readiness necessary to thrive, secure its future, and focus on its core artistic endeavors.

sections.opening_text: Old Trout Puppet Workshop stands as a celebrated Canadian non-profit, enriching communities through original theatrical productions, collaborative arts, and creative workshops. Operating within the dynamic performing arts sector, the organization navigates fluctuating revenues tied to seasonal productions and touring programs. Historically, the Executive Director has shouldered the critical but time-consuming responsibilities of daily financial administration, from data entry and invoicing to contractor payroll. This model, while demonstrating dedication, has become a bottleneck, diverting leadership attention from strategic initiatives and organizational growth. With an active Financial Committee requiring detailed oversight and the strategic imperative of preparing for a potential merger, the need for a specialized, robust financial management partner has become paramount. This engagement aims to transition Old Trout Puppet Workshop from an overburdened internal administrative model to a streamlined, professionally managed financial operation, ensuring audit readiness, enhanced transparency, and strategic financial support.

For Old Trout Puppet Workshop, establishing a meticulous and transparent accounting and bookkeeping framework is critical, especially given the organization's reliance on diverse revenue streams, project-based funding, and the need for rigorous audit preparation. The current operational environment, where the Executive Director manages daily data entry and a limited external bookkeeper handles only basic reconciliations, presents significant challenges in maintaining comprehensive, audit-ready financial records. Sympl Solutions will implement a full-cycle bookkeeping service designed to alleviate the administrative burden on the Executive Director, standardize financial processes, and ensure that all transactions are accurately recorded, categorized, and supported by proper documentation within QuickBooks Online.

subsections.heading: Bookkeeping & General Ledger Management
bullets: Process and categorize all weekly financial transactions, including revenues and expenses.
Maintain and update the QuickBooks Online chart of accounts for program and fund visibility.
Utilize Dext for digital receipt capture and expense documentation.
Ensure accurate GL coding for all transactions to support project-based tracking.
subsections.narrative:
Accurate and timely recording of all financial transactions forms the bedrock of sound financial management, particularly for a non-profit with varied income sources like performance fees, donations, and external ticketing. Maintaining a clean and well-structured general ledger is essential for generating reliable financial statements and supporting project-based tracking.

Sympl will establish a disciplined weekly bookkeeping cadence, ensuring that all financial activities are captured promptly. We will utilize QuickBooks Online as the central accounting platform, maintaining a chart of accounts that supports program-level and fund-accounting visibility. Our approach emphasizes consistency, accuracy, and adherence to non-profit accounting standards.

Weekly, Sympl will process all incoming bills and outgoing payments, ensuring proper GL coding and attachment of supporting documentation directly within QuickBooks Online. We will integrate Dext for efficient receipt capture and mobile expense ingestion, eliminating manual tracking and paper receipts. Revenue streams, including performance fees, CanadaHelps donations, and external ticketing, will be systematically recorded and reconciled.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will benefit from a consistently updated and accurate general ledger, providing a clear, real-time financial picture. This systematic approach ensures that financial data is always audit-ready, supporting informed decision-making and compliance with funder requirements.

subsections.heading: Accounts Payable & Payments
bullets: Systematically review and GL code all vendor invoices and contractor payment requests.
Prepare and queue payment batches for client approval via Plooto or CIBC Online Banking/CMO.
Ensure all payment transactions have corresponding backup documentation uploaded to QBO.
Manage performance fee invoicing and track accounts receivable.
subsections.narrative:
Managing vendor payments and contractor disbursements efficiently and with proper controls is vital for maintaining vendor relationships and ensuring financial integrity. The current process, where the Executive Director handles bill payments and uploads, creates a single point of failure and lacks the necessary separation of duties for robust internal controls.

Sympl will implement a structured accounts payable workflow that incorporates transparent separation of duties and dual-control approval. This ensures that all payments are properly authorized, coded, and documented before disbursement, mitigating risks and enhancing accountability.

Sympl will systematically review all incoming invoices, verify their accuracy, and assign appropriate GL codes against organizational budgets. We will then queue payment batches via Plooto, allowing Old Trout leadership to approve payments with a one-touch email authorization. For payments made via CIBC Online Banking and CMO, Sympl will prepare the necessary information and ensure all backups are uploaded to QBO.

The organization will achieve a highly controlled and efficient accounts payable process, reducing the administrative burden on the Executive Director and ensuring timely, accurate, and properly authorized disbursements. This workflow provides clear audit trails and enhances financial governance.

subsections.heading: Multi-Account Reconciliations
bullets: Perform monthly reconciliations for CIBC Chequing and RBC Casino accounts.
Execute manual ledger import and reconciliation for Manulife Reserved Funds.
Reconcile the CIBC Credit Card statement against recorded expenses.
Investigate and resolve any discrepancies identified during the reconciliation process.
subsections.narrative:
Reconciling all bank and credit card accounts monthly is fundamental for verifying the accuracy of financial records, detecting discrepancies, and ensuring the completeness of financial reporting. For Old Trout Puppet Workshop, this is particularly complex due to four distinct financial institutions, including a restricted casino account and manually reconciled reserve funds.

Sympl will establish a disciplined monthly reconciliation cadence across all specified accounts. Our approach ensures that every transaction is verified against bank statements, providing a comprehensive check on financial data integrity and supporting audit readiness.

At each month-end, Sympl will perform detailed reconciliations for the CIBC Chequing account, RBC Casino account, Manulife Reserved Funds (requiring manual ledger import and reconciliation), and the personally secured CIBC Credit Card. Any discrepancies will be promptly investigated and resolved, ensuring that the QuickBooks Online ledger accurately reflects actual cash and credit positions.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will have complete assurance that all cash and credit card balances are accurate and reconciled monthly. This rigorous process is crucial for audit readiness, cash flow management, and maintaining the integrity of financial statements, especially for restricted funds.

sections.opening_text: For Old Trout Puppet Workshop, managing contractor payroll accurately and on time is essential for maintaining positive relationships with its artistic and administrative team, which includes the Executive Director, co-founding directors, hourly contractors, and Equity stage managers. The current manual calculation and direct bank transfer system, while functional, lacks the systematic tracking and compliance mechanisms required for a growing non-profit, particularly with the need for annual T4A slip generation and project-based cost allocation. Sympl Solutions will implement a streamlined payroll accounting and administration process that ensures timely and compliant contractor disbursements, relieving the Executive Director of this complex administrative burden.

subsections.heading: Contractor Payroll Processing & Compliance
bullets: Process semi-monthly and monthly contractor payments based on approved input.
Schedule and execute contractor disbursements via CMO or direct bank transfer.
Track and record all contractor compensation and related expenses in QBO.
Prepare and generate annual CRA T4A slips for all eligible contractors.
subsections.narrative:
Accurate and timely payment of contractors, along with proper tracking and annual reporting (T4As), is a critical operational function. The current manual process for Old Trout Puppet Workshop is time-consuming for the Executive Director and carries risks related to compliance and accurate record-keeping, especially with varying payment frequencies and production-based engagements.

Sympl will establish a semi-monthly and monthly payroll processing schedule tailored to the diverse needs of Old Trout's contractors. Our approach focuses on systematic tracking of contractor compensation, ensuring timely payments, and fulfilling all necessary annual reporting obligations with the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).

Upon receiving approved contractor payment data from Old Trout management, Sympl will calculate and process semi-monthly payments for the Executive Director, monthly payments for co-founding directors and the hourly contractor, and production-based payments for Equity stage managers. Payments will be scheduled via CMO (Cash Management Online) or direct bank transfer, with all associated documentation and GL coding recorded in QuickBooks Online. Annually, Sympl will prepare and generate T4A slips for all eligible contractors.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will benefit from a reliable, compliant, and efficient contractor payroll system. This will free the Executive Director from administrative payroll tasks, ensure contractors are paid accurately and on time, and guarantee that the organization meets its annual CRA reporting obligations for T4As, providing peace of mind and audit readiness.

sections.opening_text: For Old Trout Puppet Workshop, robust financial reporting is not merely a compliance exercise but a strategic imperative, especially with an active Financial Committee and the prospect of a merger. The current limited bookkeeping scope does not provide the detailed, project-based insights or the comprehensive financial packages required for effective governance and strategic decision-making. Sympl Solutions will transform the organization's financial reporting capabilities, delivering clear, actionable insights that support the Board's oversight responsibilities and enable informed strategic planning.

subsections.heading: Monthly Financial Package & Committee Reporting
bullets: Prepare and deliver monthly Statement of Operations (P&L) with project-level detail.
Generate monthly Balance Sheet and Cash Flow schedules.
Develop and present Project/Show Variance tracking reports for key productions and funds.
Coordinate delivery of financial packages for monthly Financial Committee meetings.
subsections.narrative:
The Board's Financial Committee requires timely, accurate, and comprehensive financial statements to fulfill its oversight responsibilities. Without a structured reporting process, the committee's ability to monitor financial health, assess performance, and guide strategic decisions is compromised, particularly for a non-profit with project-based funding and fluctuating revenues.

Sympl will establish a disciplined monthly reporting cycle, delivering a comprehensive financial package tailored for the Financial Committee. Our approach prioritizes clarity, accuracy, and the provision of actionable insights, ensuring that the committee has the necessary information to perform its duties effectively.

By the 15th business day following month-end close, Sympl will deliver a complete monthly financial package. This package will include a detailed Statement of Operations (P&L), a Balance Sheet, and specific Project/Show Variance tracking reports. These reports will be designed to provide clear budget-versus-actual analysis for various performance productions and restricted funds, enabling the Financial Committee to review financial performance and make informed recommendations.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop's Financial Committee will receive consistent, high-quality financial reporting packages, enabling them to conduct thorough reviews and provide effective governance. This enhanced visibility will support strategic decision-making, improve accountability, and strengthen the organization's financial oversight.

subsections.heading: Project-Based Cost Center & Grant Tracking
bullets: Configure QBO for project-based cost center and grant tracking.
Allocate revenues and expenses to specific shows, productions, and restricted funds.
Generate detailed project-level financial reports as required.
Support the tracking of restricted gaming funds in the RBC Casino account.
subsections.narrative:
As a non-profit performing arts company, Old Trout Puppet Workshop relies on project-based funding and needs to track revenues and expenses by specific shows, productions, and casino funds. The absence of clean project-based accounting makes it challenging to assess the financial performance of individual initiatives and comply with funder reporting requirements.

Sympl will configure QuickBooks Online to support robust project-based cost center and grant tracking. Our approach ensures that all relevant revenues and expenses are accurately allocated to specific projects, providing granular financial insights and facilitating compliance with restricted funding requirements.

We will work with Old Trout Puppet Workshop to define and implement a clear project-based tracking structure within QuickBooks Online. All incoming revenues (performance fees, donations, ticketing) and outgoing expenses will be coded to their respective projects or cost centers. This will enable the generation of detailed reports that show the financial performance of individual shows, productions, and the restricted RBC Casino funds, supporting both internal management and external funder reporting.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will gain clear, itemized financial visibility into the performance of each project and restricted fund. This capability is crucial for demonstrating accountability to funders, making informed decisions about future productions, and ensuring compliance with the segregation requirements for the RBC Casino account.

The current administrative model places a significant burden on the Executive Director for audit preparation and coordination, and the limited bookkeeping scope does not proactively address compliance requirements. Sympl Solutions will provide comprehensive support for GST tracking, audit preparation, and coordination with external CPA firms, ensuring that Old Trout Puppet Workshop maintains impeccable financial records and meets all regulatory obligations.

subsections.heading: GST Tracking & Working Papers
bullets: Track and categorize all GST-related revenues and expenses in QBO.
Prepare detailed working papers to support GST calculations and filings.
Coordinate with the external CPA firm for GST return preparation and submission.
Ensure compliance with CRA regulations for GST reporting.
subsections.narrative:
Accurate tracking and reporting of GST are essential for compliance with Canadian tax regulations. For a non-profit, this involves meticulous record-keeping to ensure proper remittance and to support any potential claims or audits by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA).

Sympl will implement a systematic process for tracking all GST-related transactions within QuickBooks Online. Our approach ensures that all necessary working papers are prepared accurately and are readily available for review, facilitating smooth and compliant GST filings.

Throughout the year, Sympl will ensure that all revenues and expenses are correctly categorized for GST purposes within QuickBooks Online. We will maintain detailed working papers that support the GST calculations, providing a clear audit trail. This meticulous record-keeping will enable efficient preparation and filing of GST returns, coordinating with the external CPA firm as needed.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will maintain accurate and compliant GST records, ensuring timely and correct filings. This systematic approach reduces the risk of non-compliance and streamlines the process of preparing for and responding to any CRA inquiries.

subsections.heading: Audit Support & Coordination
bullets: Prepare comprehensive audit working papers and detailed schedules.
Ensure 100% of invoice and receipt backups are attached in QBO for audit readiness.
Coordinate directly with the external CPA firm for year-end compilation and tax return.
Respond to auditor inquiries and provide necessary documentation promptly.
subsections.narrative:
Annual audits are a critical component of financial transparency and accountability for non-profit organizations. The current process, which relies heavily on the Executive Director to gather and prepare documentation, is inefficient and can lead to delays or incomplete submissions. With a potential merger on the horizon, rigorous audit readiness is paramount.

Sympl will proactively manage the audit preparation process, ensuring that all financial records, documentation, and working papers are meticulously organized and readily accessible. Our approach involves close coordination with the external CPA firm to facilitate a smooth and efficient annual audit.

Sympl will prepare comprehensive audit working papers, including detailed schedules and reconciliations, to support the external auditor's review. We will ensure that all invoice backups and receipts are properly attached and organized within QuickBooks Online, providing a complete and verifiable audit trail. Sympl will act as the primary liaison with the external CPA firm, responding to inquiries and providing any additional documentation required for the year-end compilation and tax return.

Old Trout Puppet Workshop will experience a significantly streamlined and less burdensome annual audit process. The organization will have audit-ready financial records, ensuring transparency, compliance, and a strong foundation for any future strategic initiatives, including a potential merger.

Sympl Solutions offers more than just bookkeeping services; we provide a comprehensive, consulting-driven approach to financial management tailored specifically for non-profit organizations in the arts and culture sector. Our commitment extends beyond transactional processing to delivering strategic financial clarity and operational excellence.
